I: Let $u:\mathcal{C}\to\mathcal{D}$ be a functor. For $V$ let $\mathcal{I}^u_V$ have objects $(U,\phi:V\to u(U))$ and arrows $f:(U,\phi)\to(U',\phi')$ where $u(f)\circ\phi=\phi'$.
u: Let $u:\mathcal{C}\to\mathcal{D}$ be a functor of categories. For a presheaf $\mathcal{F}$ on $\mathcal{C}$ put $u_p\mathcal{F}(V)=\operatorname{colim}_{(\mathcal{I}^u_V)^{opp}}\mathcal{F}(U)$. For a presheaf $\mathcal{G}$ on $\mathcal{D}$ put $u^p\mathcal{G}=\mathcal{G}\circ u$.
plus: Let $\mathcal{C}$ be a site and $\mathcal{F}$ a presheaf. For a covering $\mathcal{U}$ of $U$, let $H^0(\mathcal{U},\mathcal{F})$ be the set of matching families of sections over its members. Let $\mathcal{J}_U$ be the category of coverings and refinements. Define $\mathcal{F}^+(U)=\operatorname{colim}_{\mathcal{J}_U^{opp}}H^0(\mathcal{U},\mathcal{F})$, with restrictions induced by pullbacks, and denote $\theta:\mathcal{F}\to\mathcal{F}^+$ the canonical map.
